records.canonicalEnglish:
Welda: All right! Give Shoko back!!
Tomyu: Shoko?! W-what are you talking about?!
Welda: Don't play dumb, you sewer rat! If anything's happened to Shoko, every last one of you will...
Tomyu: W-wait! I was only ordered to get rid of you...
Sion: Ordered?!
Joe: What do you mean?! You'd better explain yourself!
Tomyu: N-no, I... er... that's...
Welda: I'll kill you! You hear me?!
Tomyu: A-all right, I'll talk! Commander Geist at this planet's military station is behind it all. I only... The Kidun...
Welda: Tch. I thought as much.
Tomyu: Please! I've told you everything. Let me go!
Welda: You wish!
Narration: The Federation police arrived in response to Welda's call and took Tomyu away.
